interpretation: The 21 main-table local baselines are FP16 GPU measurements. The current CPU+NPU INT8 sweep has valid candidate timings for 13 of the 21 published-reference models; the remaining eight are incomplete (six invalid before trials and two resource-interrupted). These are timing-coverage counts only: whole-model learned-matrix coverage and matched level-0 RKLLM output quality remain unqualified for every row. The separate Qwen3-0.6B timing pilot and held-out GPU-FP16-relative quality experiment are retained in measurements above; the quality experiment does not qualify the timing pilot or establish RKLLM parity. SmolVLM remains a separate mixed-precision multimodal result. Current sweep evidence: benchmark-w8a8-results.json and the CPU+NPU candidate table in ../benchmark.md.
